notes: ODL-926 (A5): the one recovery code is stable — it no longer rotates on use and never expires — and is replaced only on request, from the machine, which mints a new code, shows it once, and pushes its hash to HQ signed with the machine's heartbeat key; a five-minute timer retries until the account acknowledges. The installer re-embeds installer/first_visit.py (e69d80d7…), web/first-visit.html (a877f964…) and scripts/heartbeat.py (98c01da5…): the reset and recovery pages no longer spend or show the code, /first-visit/replace is new, and the recovery-push unit and timer are written. The manifest moves installer_sha256 and release.json names the new pair.
